fact: Finance minister Doudou Fwamba said generalised VAT e-filing (télédéclaration) at the DGI, with the phased facture normalisée, lifted monthly VAT collection from about FC 280bn to over FC 320bn.
Kinshasa's provincial finance minister announced that the Go Pass departure fee at N'djili airport will be paid electronically from July 2026, on a platform built by TRAFIGO SARL.
Kinshasa's provincial revenue directorate (DGRK) launched irms-dgrk.com on 5 March 2026 to let taxpayers file and pay provincial taxes online by several payment means.
Tshopo provincial government officially launched Veri-Gov on 21 August 2026 in Kisangani, a platform for paying provincial taxes and revenues electronically by mobile phone, per Opinion Info.
